description: Check whether a domain belongs to a typosquatting group, or expand every domain across all groups containing it. Use `mode=probe` for a fast inGroup boolean + groupId triage. Use `mode=group` to enumerate the full lookalike infrastructure once a probe hits. Do NOT use this to find newly-registered impersonation domains by pattern (use `domain_and_subdomain_discovery`) or for malware/phishing reputation (use `threat_intelligence`).

mode.description: Response shape: "probe" for boolean + groupId only (fast); "group" for full list of domains across all groups (heavier, more credits).

name: typosquatting
